svg.text: one physical core per worker first, SMT siblings last
16 workers -> 16 physical cores busy, 1 thread per core
16 workers -> 16 physical cores busy, 1 thread per core
32 workers -> 16 physical cores busy, 2 threads per core
32 workers -> 32 physical cores busy, 1 thread per core
Coloured cell = a pinned OpenSSL worker is running on that hardware thread. Grey = idle thread.
Going from 16 to 32 workers, Intel adds a second worker to each already-busy core; AMD adds 16 untouched cores.
